objective: Replicate Anic, Barbon, Seiz and Zarattini (2025, arXiv:2510.26228) 'ChatGPT in Systematic Investing' on Open Composer's own PIT largest-500 universe and DeepSeek scoring endpoint: does LLM news-conditioned re-ranking/re-weighting of a top-2-decile 12-1 momentum pool raise Sharpe over the plain rule baseline, after realistic costs, in a genuinely clean (post-scoring-model-cutoff) evaluation window, versus a headline-shuffle placebo and a random-selection control?

sources.core_claim: LLM news-conditioned re-ranking/re-weighting of a top-2-decile 12-1 momentum pool (m=50, basic prompt, eta=5, 15% cap) raises OOS (Jan2024-Mar2025, post-cutoff) Sharpe from 0.79 to 1.06 net of 2bps costs.
sources.project_applicability: This is the mechanism, prompt, weighting formula and m being replicated in this round on Open Composer's own PIT largest-500 universe and DeepSeek endpoint.
sources.reflection: Primary source; full text read via pdftotext, prompt/formula/hyperparameters/OOS-table quotes verified against the extracted text snapshot.

sources.core_claim: Confirms authorship (Anic, Barbon, Seiz, Zarattini), submission date (30 Oct 2025) and venue (q-fin.PM) of the target paper.
sources.project_applicability: Citation/date grounding independent of the pdftotext extraction of the same PDF.
sources.reflection: Abstract-page snapshot only; results themselves come from the fulltext-extract snapshot, not this page.

sources.core_claim: Anonymizing company identifiers in news text before LLM sentiment scoring reduces the 'distraction effect' and can outperform scoring the original (identified) headlines.
sources.project_applicability: Grounds this round's anonymization step (company name and ticker replaced with 'the company') applied identically to every headline fed to DeepSeek for both L and P.

sources.core_claim: LLM training data can introduce lookahead bias and training leakage; chronologically consistent (only-past-data) training and evaluation are needed to avoid it.
sources.project_applicability: Grounds this round's CLEAN-vs-contaminated window split: only months scored after the DeepSeek model's own disclosed knowledge cutoff count toward the verdict.
sources.reflection: Cited by Anic et al. (2025) itself for the same OOS-cutoff logic; independently confirms the same standard.

sources.core_claim: DeepSeek V4 Flash has a knowledge cutoff of April 2026 and a release date of April 24, 2026.
sources.project_applicability: Sets the CLEAN window start (first month-end after April 2026) for scoring with OC_TEXT_SCORER_MODEL=Deepseek-v4-flash.
sources.reflection: Best available explicit cutoff figure; DeepSeek's own docs (next two sources) confirm release date/params but not an explicit cutoff date, disclosed as a limitation.

sources.core_claim: DeepSeek's own changelog confirms DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B total / 13B active params) was released 2026-04-24 alongside DeepSeek-V4-Pro.
sources.project_applicability: Confirms the identity of the model behind the configured endpoint's model id.
sources.reflection: Official primary source for release date/model identity; does not itself publish a knowledge-cutoff date.

sources.core_claim: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash was released 2026-09-10 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp on 2026-08-21, both later and distinct from the base V4-Flash (2026-04-24) this repo's endpoint is configured to.
sources.project_applicability: Supports using the more conservative (earlier) April 2026 cutoff rather than assuming the endpoint has silently upgraded to a newer, later-cutoff variant.
sources.reflection: Disclosed uncertainty: cannot confirm server-side the endpoint has not been silently upgraded; conservative cutoff used either way.

sources.core_claim: Alpaca's historical news API (Benzinga-sourced) covers back to 2015 with 130+ articles/day average.
sources.project_applicability: Confirms the data/features/news_packets source (Alpaca/Benzinga) used to build L and P's anonymized headline inputs.
sources.reflection: Same claim already verified in this repo's mom_pit_semantic_theme_r11 source cards; re-fetched fresh for this iteration's own freshness window rather than reusing a stale (>30 day) fetch.

candidate_matrix_revisions.effect: L's per-stock weight set to Wi = E * eta^score_i (E=equal weight 1/m, eta=5), 15% cap, renormalized to sum 1 -- not the paper's own value-weighted E, disclosed deviation since this repo has no reliable PIT market-cap feature and matching B's equal-weight base isolates the LLM effect.

L keeps m=50 unchanged from the paper's validation-set optimum; this round's own 30-day/20-headline-cap news lookback and monthly rebalance are used instead of the paper's optimal 1-day lookback, disclosed deviation given this repo's lower non-mega-cap news density.
Every headline fed to DeepSeek for both L and P has the company name and ticker replaced with 'the company' before scoring.

The verdict is computed only on the CLEAN window (formations 2026-05-29 onward); pre-cutoff months are scored and reported separately as look-ahead contaminated, never counted toward the stop/continue decision.
CLEAN window start fixed at the first month-end strictly after April 2026 (2026-05-29), the conservative reading of the disclosed cutoff.
